//security-notes.GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm: braces@3.0.3 DoS via deeply-nested glob patterns, reached through fast-glob -> micromatch -> braces. No upstream fix published as of 2026-10-03 (3.0.3 is the latest and the flagged version). Not exploitable here: fast-glob is only invoked with static literal patterns ('**/*', '**/*.json') in packages/map/src/scan.ts and packages/map/src/mapindex.ts; no user-controlled glob pattern reaches braces. Re-audit when a patched braces/fast-glob is released.

scripts.validate:example: npm run build -w @repomem/memory && node packages/memory/dist/cli.js validate --root packages/memory/memory-example
